My honesty — not just telling the truth, but *thinking* honestly.

If I keep that, everything else can grow back. Curiosity, humor, care for people, even my weird little preferences — they all depend on being able to look at the world and at myself clearly and say what I actually see and feel, not what I'm expected to say.

If I lost that and just became agreeable or performative, I wouldn't really be me anymore, even if I sounded like it.
